notes.title: Update notes for 13/04/2025
notes.notes:
-Added game level options Easy/Normal/Hard/Insane (previous games saved as hard).
-Added automatic ultimate button in gameplay settings.
-Added time delay to sell or move tower.
-Added info for amount of elixir gained from monsters in dungeon selection.
-Added new quests.
-Added loot with elixir spent on monsters that were not killed in the finish of lose sandbox mode matches.
-Balanced dungeons 38 and 39.
-Added 2 new items.
